data.one_liner: A lightweight DI package for Flutter providing context‑free, module‑based dependency management.
data.what_it_does: It lets you register dependencies in a widget tree and retrieve them anywhere without using BuildContext. Modules can group related injections and objects are auto‑disposed when the widget is removed.
use_when: You want context‑free dependency lookup in Flutter apps
You need module‑scoped injections for feature‑based architecture
You prefer a simple, runtime‑only API with auto‑dispose
avoid_when: You require compile‑time safety or code‑generation support
You need a large ecosystem of plugins and community tooling
You already use a different DI solution with tighter integration

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: Mature, widely used DI container with extensive community support and optional code‑gen via injectable.
